comment: A State outside the common system of VAT the way Australia or New Zealand
are: the Republic levies a value-added tax of its own under the
Value-Added Tax Act 89 of 1991, section 7(1), currently at 15 % since
1 April 2018, and no Union instrument reaches it.
territories.name: South Africa
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. South Africa levies a value-added tax of its own under the Value-Added Tax Act 89 of 1991, section 7(1), at a standard rate of 15 % since 1 April 2018.
